content: ok idea for a project - call this project starting a substack" - I'm thinking of starting a Substack about urban balcony gardening. I'll share what I've learned growing vegetables in my apartment. Going to start with basic free content about containers soil and plant recommendations. Take some photos of my setup to show what's possible. Plan to post weekly with seasonal gardening tips. Eventually add a paid subscription option for more detailed guides and personal advice. ill start by telling friends and my social media followers. Keep it simple and authentic just sharing my passion for growing food in small spaces. If people find it helpful great. If not at least I'll have documented my gardening journey. Might collaborate with other urban gardening enthusiasts later on. Main goal is just to share knowledge and maybe make a little side income from something I enjoy doing anyway.""
